definitions: A character in Charles Dickens's novel Oliver Twist, known for his skill in picking pockets and his cunning nature.
A person who is clever and deceitful, especially one who avoids capture or responsibility.
examples: The Artful Dodger taught Oliver how to pick pockets.
He was an Artful Dodger, always finding a way out of trouble.
She was called an Artful Dodger for her ability to evade the police.
